evaluation_mode: per-fold retraining (program doc §5.3): fold k's PPO seeds were trained on exactly fold.train (rolling window), exported torch-free behind the rl-09 parity gate, and replayed over fold.test through trading.rl.scoring.rollout (Tier B); train_sharpe = the same frozen policy REPLAYED over its own train window (in-sample, GATE-OVERFIT only)
notes: val windows are unused: training is the fixed-budget rl-08 configuration (no early stopping / model selection), so no validation number exists to quote
ppo_untrained = each seed's PPO at initialization (total_timesteps=0), retrained and exported per fold through the identical path; it separates 'PPO learned' from 'the env is trivially profitable'
GATE-LEARN null = the random policy TURNOVER-MATCHED per fold to the agent (rl-07 matched_trade_probability); 'random' rows are the uniform (1/3) baseline
risk_clipped_fraction is 0.0 by construction: the Tier B env path has no RiskGate
the walk-forward test span INCLUDES the final ~2 years the program doc reserves as a look-once holdout; every run of this job is a look and n_configurations_evaluated counts it
IQM CIs are stratified bootstraps (seeds resampled within each fold; folds fixed) and understate fold-level uncertainty; the gates read the fold-clustered CR0 SE with t(K-1)
